title: Jyn Erso
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
description: Jyn Erso grew up among Saw Gerrera's Rebel extremists. Cassian Andor recruited her to understand a message her father, Galen, managed to smuggle out. Jyn and Cassian formed a team for a raid on Scarif to steal the plans for the Death Star. Jyn  transmitted the plans to the Rebellion before the Death Star fired on Scarif, killing her and Cassian.
